# CSV fixtures

These files imitate the **layout** of exports from Argenta, Hello bank! (BNP Paribas Fortis
format) and Keytrade Bank, as far as publicly known. Names, IBANs and amounts are made up.

They are approximations. Replace them with real, anonymised exports (keep the header row and a few
rows, blank out names and amounts) and run `npm test` to confirm the import still recognises them.
